news.headline: 3 Machinery Dividend Stocks to Buy in December After a Brutal Selloff
news.summary: Caterpillar, Deere, and Emerson all tumbled in a single week, yet their payouts barely strain earnings. One of them hasn't raised its dividend in nearly two years, and this month's board decision could change the story for income investors.

news.headline: The Dow Jones Did Something It Hasn’t Done Since October 2008
news.summary: Five brutal sessions erased nearly all of the Dow's 2026 gains, yet the biggest AI name barely moved the index. Two high-priced stocks did the real damage, and the last time this happened, a rally fooled almost everyone.

news.headline: Cathie Wood and 10 Other Big Funds Sold Caterpillar Last Quarter, While 13 Bought. Who’s Right?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 13 bought Caterpillar and 11 sold, Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest among the sellers. The sellers moved far more money: Alphinity Investment Management’s cut was worth about $181 million, against about $21 million for the biggest buy.

news.headline: Cathie Wood Just Sold $11 Million of Deere
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCathie Wood’s ARK Invest sold 17,414 shares of Deere from one ETF on Nov. 20, worth about $11 million at that day’s close.

news.headline: Dow Jones Losers on Nov. 20, 2026: NVIDIA and Goldman Sachs Lead Declines
news.summary: Dow Jones losers on Nov. 20, 2026: NVIDIA fell 11.8% and Goldman Sachs 6.13%, leading declines also seen in Caterpillar, Cisco, Amazon, Nike, JPMorgan, Boeing, and Microsoft.
